sources.name: Open-Meteo Weather
sources.notes: Forecast connector implemented on Day 4. Historical weather connector is planned for model-training data.

sources.name: NASA SMAP Soil Moisture
sources.notes: Candidate independent satellite reference for soil-moisture component checks. Because the index already includes soil moisture, this is not by itself ground truth for the full composite index. See config/reference_target_registry.json.

sources.name: Central Ground Water Board Monitoring
sources.notes: Candidate independent hydrological context or target for a separately defined groundwater-stress task. Station, cadence, local relevance, and source coverage require review. See config/reference_target_registry.json.

sources.name: Karnataka Ground Water Department telemetry via National Water Data Portal
sources.notes: Day 10 connector for the Karnataka six-hourly 2021-2025 CSV resource. Source data are not committed; the quality report and rejected-row quarantine are generated locally. Observations remain candidate reference records until reviewed.
